result:
The fix is PR #2731 (merge commit `1f4098170806704451ed195a9922dc1a30ebcedc`, ticket O3-5958). It changed the new queue entry form's default queue location so it starts from the location the Service Queues dashboard resolved and stored, instead of only the login location.

**The fix**

- The form's `defaultValues` now reads `queueLocation: selectedQueueLocationUuid ?? sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''` (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/queue-fields.component.tsx:81`). Before the fix it was `sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`.
- The same file now pulls `selectedQueueLocationUuid` from `useServiceQueuesStore()` (line 68).
- The PR changed two files: that component, and `queue-fields.test.tsx`, which gained 17 lines of tests for the pre-fill behaviour.

**Why the dashboard value was available**

- The dashboard header resolves the login location if it is queue-tagged, otherwise its nearest queue-tagged ancestor, otherwise "All" (`openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/patient-queue-header/queue-location-header-title.component.tsx:35-41`).
- It stores that result via `updateSelectedQueueLocationUuid` (same file, line 56; the store function is in `packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/store/store.ts:45`).

**Review history**

- The first version of the PR used a `useEffect` that re-applied the session location. Reviewer dkayiwa pointed out that this overrode user selections and made the "Select a queue location" option unpickable. The author dropped the effect in favour of the `defaultValues` change, and the PR title and description were corrected to match.

I did not check out the merged code to run the tests.
